SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oe.IS_WON THEN oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oe.IS_CLOSED THEN oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID END), 0) AS win_rate_vs_splunk
FROM OFFICE_DW.SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED oe
JOIN OFFICE_DW.SFDC.OPPORTUNITY o ON oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID = o.ID
WHERE LOWER(o.COMPETITOR_C) LIKE '%splunk%'
  AND oe.IS_CLOSED = TRUE;
